summary: Neural Systems & Behavior is an advanced research training course at the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, United States, on the neural basis of behavior. It is aimed at graduate students, postdoctoral researchers and independent investigators. The 2027 course runs from 1 June to 12 July 2027, and applications are due by 2 February 2027.
